questions.stem: A 95% method is repeated in 200 independent experiments. About how many of the resulting intervals would you expect to contain the true value?

questions.explain: |x − 10| is the distance from x to 10. Distance at most 2 means x is within 2 of 10, which is 8 to 12.

questions.stem: In how many ways can you choose a sample of 2 people from a group of 5 (order does not matter)?
What is the integral of x/2 from 0 to 1?
questions.explain: An anti-derivative is x²/4. Evaluating it from 0 to 1 gives 1/4 − 0 = 0.25.

questions.stem: X is normal with mean 50 and standard deviation 4. What is the z-score of x = 58?
What is the population standard deviation of the values 2, 2, 6, 6?
questions.explain: The mean is 4. Every value is 2 away from it, so the variance is 4 and the standard deviation is 2.
